## Notes from the two readings

- Claude: 20 runs, 8-1 to 8-20. D 4 (8-1 to 8-8) and 6 (8-9 to 8-20). D_r 0.53 and gamma 104.0 in every run (table); text 2-110 (PDF 135) gives about 0.6 for the soil 8 roller beds. Missing: fill depth of each bed and runs per bed, footpad dimensions beyond D (the 4 inch pad not at all), whether the pad pivot was free or locked, how the pad was brought to depth d, A_ft and A_pt values, per-run density (g_p varies, D_r and gamma are one value per table), gravity (Earth inferred).
- Codex: 20 runs. Table D_r and gamma constant. Text 2-110 gives preparation D_r about 0.6. Exact pad profile and run-specific fill depth unreported.
